Linux, unlicensed (no HYPERWHISPER_ACCOUNT_KEY in the box). Filed #924: the Test dictation step renders one blocked string for all 4 conjuncts of IsTestReady. vocabulary and provider-settings were walked hard and were clean. TRAP: start the app with PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pulse-*/native. pulseaudio started without XDG_RUNTIME_DIR puts its socket in /tmp, the app looks in XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, the microphone list is then EMPTY and Codex files 2 fake defects about it. gui setup/exec/drive need --container <name>, but fuzz-drive calls gui with no flag, so rename the container to gui before you drive.
